title: Adjustments to CPF Interest Rates Given Inflation
what_it_is: Adjustments to CPF Interest Rates Given Inflation

sections.label: OA interest rate peg
sections.summary: OA savings are liquid and its interest rate is pegged to three local banks' fixed deposit and savings rates, last changed in 1999.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Ordinary Account (OA) savings is in a liquid account that can be withdrawn at any time for home purchases, for the servicing mortgage loans or other specified purposes, such as investments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Thus, the OA interest rate is pegged to the three-month average fixed deposit and savings rates of our three major local banks, which are DBS, UOB and OCBC.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The formula was last changed in 1999 when the ratio of fixed deposits to savings was updated from 50/50 to 80/20.

sections.label: OA and SMRA floor rates
sections.summary: OA and SMRA interest rates are maintained at 2.5% and 4% respectively as these are below the effective floor rates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As these are below the effective floor rates for these accounts, the interest rates for the OA and SMRA are maintained at 2.5% and 4% respectively.

sections.label: Extra interest on CPF balances
sections.summary: The Government will continue paying 1% extra interest on the first $60,000 of members' combined CPF balances, with those 55 and above earning up to 6%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Government will continue to pay the 1% of extra interest on the first $60,000 of members' combined CPF balances, 55 and above can earn up to 6%.

sections.label: CPF interest rates by age
sections.summary: Members below 55 can earn up to 5%, while members aged 55 and above can earn up to 6%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Members below aged 55 can earn up to 5%, while members aged 55 and above can earn up to 6%.

sections.label: Peg to 10-year SGS
sections.summary: Rates are pegged to the 10-year Singapore Government Securities plus 1%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To his point about the longer-term returns as to whether we can peg it, if you look at where we are today, we peg the rates to the 10-year Singapore Government Securities plus 1%.

sections.label: Average delta of CPF rates
sections.summary: The average incremental difference CPF has paid is 0.9%, and since 1 July 1999 the OA average delta is 1.8%, double the SMRA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The average delta, that means the incremental difference that CPF has paid is 0.9%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For the Ordinary Account, the interest rate peg has been below the legislated minimum floor of 2.5% because, if you appreciate the fact that for the Ordinary Account, we pegged it to the prevailing interest rates of the three local banks – DBS, UOB and OCBC.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, using the peg with our legislative minimum floor of 2.5%, since 1 July 1999, the average delta is double that of the SMRA, which is at 1.8%.
